# Brad's Tech Talk — playthrough impressions and tips

- Original source: [Brad's Tech Talk — playthrough impressions and tips](https://blog.becc.us/2011/04/06/robin-hood-legend-of-sherwood)
- Author / publication: Brad / Brad's Tech Talk
- Language / date: English; 2011-04-06
- Access: Page text inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Brad reports finishing the game on both 32-bit and 64-bit Windows 7 without platform problems, but finding the later missions repetitive. His main criticism is the recurring sequence of knocking out, binding, and hiding large numbers of guards.

He discusses clovers as resurrection resources, training and production at camp, healers, and sending spare recruits for blazons. He finds Little John particularly effective in later encounters and questions the practical value of avoiding kills once recruitment is abundant.

The post reports losing control after the conversation about the king's ransom letter and using a mission-completion cheat to continue. This resembles the mission implicated by the later Steam scoring guide, but the accounts do not establish an identical cause.

**Limitations:** personal playthrough, with several approximate or uncertain details. Successful Windows 7 operation in this account does not prove compatibility for all editions or machines.
